note: How a landing is struck: the keys lab's three comps (round 2, `progressions` and `comps`), written for the sparse keys. In round 2 a comp played every bar and he heard it as too busy; here a comp is only the landing's own first bars, the chord left to ring after it. `hits` in sixteenths from the landing's downbeat: the first is the strike (both hands, the touch's velocities), the rest touch the same voicing again at `vel` of the strike, each held to where the strike ends; `minGapBars` is the gap to the next landing a comp needs, else the landing is held. An answer (the motif's post notes) never lands within two sixteenths of a touch. A theme draws one comp (`draw.json`), off a stream of its own.

rows.name: Held
rows.says: The chord struck once where it lands and left to ring: the liquid keys as they were.

rows.name: Pushed on the and of two
rows.says: The chord on one, and the right hand again, softer, on the and of two: a pushed second touch the delay can carry, then the ring.

rows.name: Two-bar breath
rows.says: One bar held, the next struck again a little softer and lifted at the second kick for a soft right-hand touch: the lab's two-bar comp, once, at the landing.
